title: Understanding Walkthrough Files
description: A walkthrough that explains the structure of .wmti.json files. Note: Only lines within the step's line_start to line_end range get highlighted with a light background.

steps.title: JSON Structure
steps.description: Every walkthrough starts with metadata: title, description, and version. Only the opening brace and title field are highlighted here (line 2).

steps.title: Steps Array
steps.description: The 'steps' array contains navigation points. This step highlights just the 'steps' key (line 5) to show where steps begin.

steps.title: Single Step Definition
steps.description: Each step needs: id, title, description, file, line_start, line_end, action. This step shows a minimal 2-line step definition (lines 7-8).

steps.title: Line Range Usage
steps.description: The line_start and line_end fields determine which lines get highlighted. Lines within this range get a light background in the view; other lines show as context.
